description_en: Query the list of warning machines for a specific baseline check item
description_zh: 查询基线检查项风险影响的机器列表
name: ListCheckItemWarningMachine

parameters.help_en: The ID of the check item
parameters.name: check_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the check item
parameters.name: risk_type

parameters.help_en:
The status of the check item. Valid values:

1: failed
2: verifying
3: passed
6: ignored
7: fixing
8: fixed
parameters.help_zh:
检查项状态。默认为null。取值：

1：未通过
2：验证中
3：已通过
6：已忽略
7：修复中
8：已修复
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The keyword that is used to query servers in fuzzy match mode
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en: The name of the field that is used to query containers
parameters.help_zh: 容器安全查询参数名称
parameters.name: container_field_name

parameters.help_en: The value of the field that is used to query containers
parameters.name: container_field_value

parameters.help_en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。默认值为zh。取值：

zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。起始值为1。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned on each page.

We recommend that you do not leave this parameter empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the asset group.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/130972.html operation to query the ID of the asset group
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的资产分组ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/130972.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en:
The data source. Default value: default. Valid values:

default: The check items of baselines for hosts.
agentless: The check items of baselines for agentless detection
parameters.help_zh:
数据来源，为空时默认查询主机基线结果。取值：
default：主机
agentless：agentless
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en: The UUID array of the servers
parameters.name: uuid_list

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member in the resource directory.

You can call the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain the IDs
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号ID（阿里云账号）。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

items.description_en: The server on which the alert is generated

AuthVersion.description_en:
The edition of Security Center that is authorized to protect the asset. Valid values:

1: Basic edition
6: Anti-virus edition
5: Advanced edition
3: Enterprise edition
7: Ultimate edition
10: Value-added Plan edition

资产的授权版本。取值：

1：免费版
6：防病毒版
5：高级版
3：企业版
7：旗舰版
10：仅采购增值服务版

Bind.description_en:
Indicates whether Security Center is authorized to protect the asset. Valid values:

true
false
Bind.description_zh:
资产是否已绑定授权。取值：

true：已绑定授权
false：未绑定授权

FixList.description_zh: 检出此检查项风险的可修复基线列表

items.description_zh: 检出此检查项风险的可修复基线

RiskName.example: Alibaba Cloud Linux/Aliyun Linux 2 Baseline for China classified protection of cybersecurity-Level II

是否支持修复。取值：

0：不支持
